description: This file contains function prototypes, type definitions, macros, and constants for GPIO configuration and control on STM32F10x microcontrollers.

methods.name: GPIO_DeInit
methods.description: De-initializes the specified GPIO port to its default reset state.

methods.name: GPIO_AFIODeInit
methods.description: De-initializes the Alternate Function I/O registers to their default reset state.

methods.name: GPIO_Init
methods.description: Initializes the GPIOx peripheral according to the specified parameters in GPIO_InitStruct.

methods.name: GPIO_StructInit
methods.description: Fills each GPIO_InitStruct member with its default value.

methods.name: GPIO_ReadInputDataBit
methods.description: Reads the specified input port pin.

methods.name: GPIO_ReadInputData
methods.description: Reads the input data port of the specified GPIO port.

methods.name: GPIO_ReadOutputDataBit
methods.description: Reads the specified output port pin.

methods.name: GPIO_ReadOutputData
methods.description: Reads the output data port of the specified GPIO port.

methods.name: GPIO_SetBits
methods.description: Sets the selected data port bits.

methods.name: GPIO_ResetBits
methods.description: Resets the selected data port bits.

methods.name: GPIO_WriteBit
methods.description: Sets or clears the selected data port bit.

methods.name: GPIO_Write
methods.description: Writes data to the port output data register.

methods.name: GPIO_EventOutputConfig
methods.description: Configures the GPIO event output source.

methods.name: GPIO_EventOutputCmd
methods.description: Enables or disables the GPIO event output.

methods.name: GPIO_PinRemapConfig
methods.description: Remaps the GPIO pins according to the specified remap configuration.

methods.name: GPIO_EXTILineConfig
methods.description: Configures the EXTI line for the specified GPIO port and pin.
